title: lupinus bicolor subsp. microphyllus
intro: Lupinus bicolor subsp. microphyllus, commonly known as the Miniature Lupine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family that belongs to the Lupinus bicolor species. The Miniature Lupine is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antiseptic and antifungal properties. Studies suggest that the plant's therapeutic actions may be attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Lupinus bicolor subsp. microphyllus for medicinal purposes.
